item.summary: fix(gateway): stamp creation provenance on sessions.patch-created sessions (#128774) The sessions.patch create path skipped createdVia and createdActor, making the creator own session invisible under createSessionListEntryFilter when gateway.roles sets sessions.others=none. Thread resolveOperatorSessionCreation through sessions-patch-engine into projectSessionsPatchEntry and stamp only genuinely new rows, mirroring session-create-service. Preserve existing rows and placeholder aliases without restamping their provenance. Add an owner-boundary regression proving the identified creator can see and update a patch-created session. Follow-up of #128548.
